title: Magic Square Transformation Explorer
description: Interactive step-based magic square transformation explorer for Grade 7 Mathematics — Chapter 6: Number Play. Redesigned with Singularity Design System: Poppins font, #4A4DC9 indigo + #FF7212 orange primary palette, #533086-to-#FC9145 gradient, #C1C1EA/#FFF3E4 light fills, #4E4E4E/#CACACA/#EBEBEB/#F5F5F5 grey scale. Contained/Outlined/Texted button variants with 40px height, 24px padding, 20px border-radius.

transformations.description: Array of transformation configs with label, description, grid, magicSum, operation, color

teaching_notes.step_1: Let the student verify all eight sums of the Lo Shu.
teaching_notes.step_2: Emphasize adding 1 to each of 3 cells adds 3 to row sum.
teaching_notes.step_3: Ask WHY doubling works — distributive property.
teaching_notes.step_4_5: Enable prediction using pattern: adding k increases magic sum by 3k.
teaching_notes.algebraic: Centre number m determines magic sum as 3m.

instructions_for_student: Start with the Lo Shu magic square (1-9, magic sum 15). Watch what happens to the magic sum as we apply different transformations. At each step, try to predict the new magic sum before it is revealed!

curriculum_context.subject: Mathematics
curriculum_context.section: 6.3 Some Explorations in Grids — Magic Squares
